indicator.name: Health facilities assessed per 10,000 residents
indicator.description: Facilities assessed in the August–September 2023 Kenya Health Facility Census per 10,000 KNBS projected 2023 residents.
indicator.expected_source: MoH Kenya Health Facility Census 2023 + KNBS Gross County Product 2024 projected 2023 population
indicator.expected_availability_note: Atlas-derived 2023 county rate using same-year official numerator and denominator. County only in P20; constituency/ward activation requires its own numerator and denominator mapping.
